variants.title: Шёлковый бант
variants.prompt: Create a new original logo-brand concept for a sophisticated womenswear boutique. Exact text "DONAmour": uppercase D O N A, lowercase m o u r. One uninterrupted name, no space, no slogans. Second creative direction: bespoke lyrical gently slanted serif lettering, restrained 7-degree forward motion, sculpted soft wedge terminals, graceful pen-shaped curves, moderately thick strokes and open counters, sophisticated optical spacing. Authorial lettering, never a generic wedding script, no excessive swashes. The whole word must be beautifully readable. A small original emblem is composed to the LEFT of the word with breathing room, emblem height about the capital D height, never replacing letters. Ruby #66021F flat ink on uniform pale rose #FFE9EC. One centered finished horizontal logo, generous margins, refined mature femininity, no mockup, border, extra text, duplicate logo, gradient, shadow or 3D. Draw from first principles, do not imitate existing designers or trademarks. A loosely tied silk ribbon with two narrow unequal elongated loops and one softly curving tail. Fluid asymmetric brush-drawn silhouette with two negative-space fold cuts, like a small artisan silk knot; NOT a symmetrical gift bow.
